skill_name: Summarize the synopsis of the movie Avengers: Infinity War.
workflow: Avengers: Infinity War is an American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics superhero team the Avengers. It is the sequel to 2012's The Avengers and 2015's Avengers: Age of Ultron, and the 19th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). The film follows the Avengers and their allies as they attempt to prevent Thanos, a villainous alien warlord, from acquiring the Infinity Stones, powerful artifacts that he believes will grant him ultimate power.
